description: AFK+ orders at work (services/cloud-afk/README.md, 'AFK+ trade orders'; services/afk-agent/README.md, 'Bargaining', 'The last gate'). 'status': an order's status from its 'state' (now, got: its progress, live: the machine's live state of it or null, allow: the account's sides); statuses win in the order of 'statuses'. 'progress': receipts ({t: Unix ms, o: order, k: kind bits, q: quantity}) per order: got and when it last grew (Unix seconds); under review (k & 8) and deals without an order do not count. 'bounds': the price bound of n items (buying the most, selling the least; money or the paying item's count). 'deals': whether a deal fits its order ('ctx.opening' true at deal_open, false when an open deal is checked again after the document changed); reasons order, blocked, not_friend, reply, req, qty, day, limit, spending, cap, approval (afk-host applies them with what it knows: services/afk-agent/README.md, 'The last gate'). 'terms': 'Süreyi uzat' (extend) and 'Yeniden başlat' (restart) at 'now'. 'remaining' and 'room': what is left of an order and a buy order's room today (limits.buyStacksPerDay stacks). Generated by generate-afkplus-order-v1.mjs from hand-written expectations checked against afkplus-order.mjs; do not edit by hand.

total, part of it, selling rounds up
